plan.title: Service PR to RFQ Award and PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Set and commit the 30-minute event duration.

args.goal: set the evaluation duration to 30 minutes and add one required Terms and Conditions clause on the buyer create screen; stop with the saved schedule and required clause visible

steps.note: Configure the required evaluation duration and add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the completed RFQ.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote at 100 per activity through the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A's bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's quote at 90 per activity through the second vendor session.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before comparison and award.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify the second vendor, Vendor B, is ranked first.
Verify ranking follows the lowest quoted amounts across the activities.
Award the complete event to the lowest vendor, Vendor B.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for service PR award to the lowest vendor.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order from the award.
Verify the PO carries both awarded service activities.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event is in history.
Open the History tab.
Verify this plan's event appears in event history.
